scope: Derived LOD geometry and texture tiers for the two existing props; existing form and placement retained

fountain.medium: Overall outline, raised figure, tiers, streams and material separation remain close to the original in both views.
fountain.far: Faceting is visible on the basin perimeter and raised arms at approximately 290-pixel object height. At approximately 75 pixels the subject and streams remain recognisable. Use only at small projected size.

beehive.medium: Cabinet, roof, timber borders, honeycomb frames and both side bee badges retain their silhouette. Honeycomb highlights become slightly more distinct.
beehive.far: Wood grain is softer and honeycomb highlights lose fine detail, while roof, cabinet, doors and badges stay readable. No cell deletion was used to force the nominal 5% budget.

result: Ready for runtime comparison with screen-size LOD thresholds; no blocking asset defect observed in reviewed views
limitations: Studio orthographic views, not the production perspective camera
Only front and reverse obliques were inspected
96-pixel comparisons are downsampled from the 384-pixel render, not independent low-resolution GPU renders
Alpha silhouette overlap does not prove perceptual equivalence or collision correctness
No GPU timing, frame-rate, peak-memory, interaction or LOD-transition measurement in this package
No human approval or deployment occurred
